scoring_justification: Intersection fields h*(L) are recomputed from the raw xi_over_L_data.csv using linear interpolation and compared to paper-reported values (T1). Barrier and critical exponents are scored via reference match (T0) because no raw tethered-field traces are submitted that would permit a full recompute of those quantities.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold values for intersection field h*(L), free-energy barriers Delta_F/N per L, fitted theta, per-size exponent estimates, and final critical exponents.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Values transcribed directly from the published tables; per-L exponent arrays taken from Table I rows L=8,12,16; final estimates from discussion.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's own reported numbers, traceable to specific table cells, and they represent the target the reproduction must match. They are not fabricated.

outputs.description: CSV containing ξ/L vs h for each L at T=1.6. Structural audit ensures correct columns and reasonable range; the main scoring is carried out on the derived exponents.
Free-energy barrier per spin for each L and the fitted θ. Checker compares the barriers and θ to hidden reference values from the paper.
Critical exponents extracted via the quotients method. The checker compares per-size intersection fields and final exponent estimates to hidden paper values within tolerances.

output_contract.notes: The three scored artifacts are the final computational outputs of the reproduction. The ξ/L CSV provides raw data for structural checks; the barrier and exponent JSON files carry the main reward through reference comparison to the paper's reported results.
